list: The official 55 trophies, frozen 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55).
note: Missable flags and hidden flags are our reading of the official descriptions, not a claim checked in the game. GTA games usually let you replay story missions, so treat a missable flag as do-it-when-you-see-it, not as a confirmed missable.

sources.covers: Every trophy name, description, grade and hidden flag.
sources.label: Exophase — official GTA VI trophy list

sources.covers: Every trophy name, description and grade, plus PSN progress targets (counts).
sources.label: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list

sources.covers: Each guide below is written from the official description alone. The game released 19 Nov 2026 and we have not played it: where a place or step is not pinned down by the description, the guide says so instead of inventing one.
sources.label: Our own advice, from the official description

trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order (story, side strands, activities, collectibles, cleanup) and this pops last. Difficulty is the whole list, not one task.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing — it is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Nothing to prepare; just play through the opening.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Play through every mission of Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies unlock on completion, so there is no side task — keep following the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Finish Chapter 2 in full. As with every chapter trophy, the only requirement is completing the chapter's missions in order.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Finish Chapter 3 in full. If you are cleaning up side content, do it between chapters — the chapter trophy itself only needs the story missions done.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Finish Chapter 4 in full. By this point most side strands and activities are open, so it is a good moment to clear a few before the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story, unmissable, and the gold for finishing the game. Complete the final mission. Before you start it, grab any one-time moments you still need (see the Missables tab) — after the finale, some chances may not come back.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story mission, unmissable. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when the story reaches it. Mission trophies unlock on completion; no extra objective is named in the official description.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story mission, unmissable. Complete The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in GTA usually have a setup chain first — finish the setups the story gives you, then the heist itself.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story mission, unmissable. Complete the mission Child's Play when it appears in the story. No extra objective is named in the official description.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story mission, unmissable. Complete the mission Headliners. The name suggests a set-piece mission — follow the on-screen objectives and it unlocks on completion.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story mission, unmissable. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. The name points at Vice City International Airport — expect a vehicle or aircraft takedown as the mission's core.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story mission, unmissable. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The official description names no extra objective, so completion alone earns it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The second gold, and the real grind behind the platinum. Reach 100% completion in the game's own checklist (story, strands, activities, collectibles — the in-game stats page shows what counts). This is a late-game trophy: leave it until every other category is done, then use the in-game checklist to find the last few percent.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Grind trophy, not missable — stunts can be done any time in free roam. PSN tracks 250 stunts: jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time all count as stunts in GTA games. Fastest path: a fast car or bike, long straight roads and stunt jumps, repeated in short loops. Chip away at it between missions rather than leaving all 250 for the end.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sampler trophy. Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, racing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and stunts are the types the other trophies name. You only need to try each once, not win or finish it, so run through the list early and it pops quickly.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Skill trophy: gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own gold score or time, shown at the range. Tips from the description alone: use the weapon the challenge gives you, aim for headshots where the scoring rewards them, and replay a challenge freely — failed attempts cost nothing but time. Save this for after the story, when your shooting is warmed up.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race — winning once per location is enough, and you can retry a location as often as needed. Learn each course's corners on a practice run, then race for the win; the drone handles like a fast, drifty vehicle, so brake early for tight turns.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Races are spread across Leonida (street, off-road and water races all count where offered). Pick the shortest races first and use the fastest vehicle in its class; retrying a race you lost is free.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is a fishing rival — find his challenge at a fishing spot (the opening mission Gone Fishing introduces fishing). Match his catch by using the right bait and reeling steadily; losing a challenge just means challenging him again.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, any game, any arcade. Find an arcade in Leonida, start a cabinet game and play it to its end — you do not need a high score, just a completion. Good early trophy: it also counts toward trying each activity type.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side strand finale. Work through Andy's mission strand until his final mission, then complete it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore and progress the story — if Andy's strand has not appeared yet, keep playing the story and checking the map for his marker.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side strand finale. Complete Kenton's strand through to its final mission. Strands usually gate behind story progress, so if his later missions are not showing, advance the story a chapter first.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side strand finale. Finish Billy's strand and its final mission. Keep an eye on the map after each story chapter — new strand missions often appear then.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver for breadth: complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. There are more than 8 strands in the game (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and others), so you can pick the 8 you like. Start strands early — they are spread across the map — and finish one strand fully before moving on, so progress is not left half-done everywhere.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side strand finale. Complete Randy's strand through to its final mission. Like the other strand finales, it counts toward the 8 strands of Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side strand finale. Complete Tyrone's strand through to its final mission. Strand missions often involve driving or a small job — follow the marker and finish the chain.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Collectible-style activity: meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Spots are scenic viewpoints — check hilltops, beaches and quiet corners, and use the in-game map markers once one is found. It pairs well with exploring all 52 areas for The Goodtime State.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Side strand task for Bret: hunt a unique animal. Unique animals are one-of-a-kind spawns tied to Bret's strand — follow his missions and the clues they give about where the animal roams, then track and take it down. Bring a scoped rifle and approach quietly.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Silver for collecting: complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, on tables, in glove boxes and other small spots. Each set needs every card in it, so collect as you explore rather than hunting all of them at the end; a card found early is a card you do not have to backtrack for.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Silver grind: use WAiNK It (the in-game photo/tagging app) at 100 locations. Any 100 distinct spots count — tag landmarks, shops and viewpoints as you travel. The fastest route is a road trip around Leonida tagging as you go, combined with the 52-area exploration for The Goodtime State.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's open-world challenge list (stunts, races, shooting and more all feed it). You will clear many of these naturally while chasing the other trophies; check the challenges menu to see which types you are close on and finish the cheap ones first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable — do it when the chance appears. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Best done in free roam with a fast car and a planned escape route: break line of sight, hide, and wait for the wanted level to fall. Partner must be with you when the level is lost, so do not let them get separated mid-chase.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable — do it when the chance appears. With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the wanted level dropping in between. Plan a route with 3 close shops, rob fast, and keep moving — the wanted level must stay live from the first robbery to the third. A fast getaway car parked outside each shop helps.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — driving or passing a new vehicle model counts it as discovered. Variety is the point: drive different cars, bikes, boats and aircraft as you find them. It overlaps with registering 10 vehicles for On the Spot and with exploring Leonida, so it should pop during normal play.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable — do it when the chance appears. Activate Combat Focus (the slow-mo aiming mode) and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Pick a fight with a group — a gang hideout or a shootout with several enemies close together — and line up shots quickly while focus is active.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable — do it when the chance appears. At Vice City International Airport, leave in an unscheduled way: steal a plane and take off without following the airport's rules, or otherwise exit the airport by an unplanned route. The description is deliberately vague, so experiment at the airport in free roam.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Take on Rhino tanks — the military tank of the series. The description gives no count, so expect a combat moment with Rhinos (a mission or a high wanted level) where you survive or destroy one. At 5 stars the army rolls in with Rhinos; use explosives and cover, and do not fight one head-on in a normal car.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable — do it when the chance appears. Rob a jewelry store without being detected: go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards' sightlines, take the goods and leave before any alarm. Stealth matters more than speed — a silenced approach and a quick exit beat a loud smash-and-grab.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Silver for heist-style play: rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each. Bank vaults are bigger jobs than shop robberies — plan the approach, the escape route and the getaway vehicle before going in. Each vault counts only if you escape clean, so do not rush the exit.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — find one in traffic, stop it (ram it or block the road), crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level. One clean robbery is enough.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Driving or walking into a new area marks it discovered — the in-game map shows which areas you have not visited yet. Do a full map sweep in a fast car or aircraft, ticking off the blank areas; it pairs perfectly with WAiNK It at 100 locations and the 18 meditation spots.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Gang operations are marked around the map — each gang owns its own spots, so you need one robbery per gang, not nine in one place. Check the map per gang and work through the list; a stolen operation usually means a fight, so go armed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable — do it when the chance appears. Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or vendor with a view, and have a cocktail there. It is a small moment trophy: one drink with the ocean in view. Easy, but easy to forget — do it the first time you pass Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable — do it when the chance appears. Drive into (or through) a vehicle showroom and smash your way out in classic GTA style — out through the glass, not the door. Use a sturdy car, pick a showroom with a big front window, and drive straight out.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable — do it when the chance appears. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through — play a full game there. The description hints the alley itself matters, not just any bowling, so use that specific location.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Flagged missable — do it when the chance appears. The official description is cryptic by design, and we will not invent the step: it is tied to the partnership (Lucia and Jason) and to something with mass appeal — most likely a public or social-media moment in the game. Watch for a prompt or event involving the pair and a crowd or a post, and take it when it appears.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Flagged missable — do it when the chance appears. PSN tracks a count to 500 for this one: it is about choices made across the game. Keep choosing — dialogue choices, mission choices, side decisions all feed it. There is no single moment to miss; the flag is here because some choices may be one-time, so do not skip decision points when they appear.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Flagged missable — do it when the chance appears. The name says it: succeed on a second try. Fail something, then succeed at the retry — a failed mission retried, a lost race re-run, a challenge beaten on the second attempt. It should pop naturally during play; if it has not, retry any activity you failed once and finish it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Flagged missable — do it when the chance appears. A secret-moment trophy: witness something strange in Leonida. GTA games hide odd events in odd places — a strange encounter, an easter egg, an unexplained sight. Explore off the beaten path (deserts, swamps, quiet roads at night) and it should find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable — do it when the chance appears. Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. A slow drive past a pedestrian with a bat (or equivalent) does it — aim for a quiet street so you are not fighting the whole police force right after.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists; contacts clean them for a cut. Keep laundering after every big job rather than hoarding bills — the total is cumulative, so steady laundering after each score adds up to $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative, any shops, any items. Cars, clothes, weapons and property upgrades all count. Do not force it: normal spending across the game gets you most of the way, then top up with a big purchase (a car or a property) at the end.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages are bought with in-game money and give you storage for your vehicle collection. Save up and buy them as they appear — check the property listings after each story chapter for new ones.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find 10 different vehicles, then register each through the app on the in-game phone. It overlaps with discovering 100 vehicles for Whip It Good — register the interesting ones as you find them instead of leaving all 10 for the end.
trophies.name: On the Spot
